body:
This is the first step described in https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaLand.jl/issues/1723#issuecomment-5064526784 where you use the new space added in https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaCore.jl/pull/2525 in ClimaCore. The purpose is to verify that using the two different spaces doesn't result in any big differences.

Note that I ask a LLM to write a majority of the code.

Support for interpolating over the time dimension for multiple points is added here: https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaUtilities.jl/pull/248
